product.olivetti-m6-650-dp.summary: The dual-processor variant of the M6-650.
product.olivetti-m6-650-dp.history: Olivetti grouped this model with the M6-650, 670, 680 and 690 in the Tin Box chassis.
product.olivetti-m6-650-dp.architecture: The board determines how the monitor connects. The BA2189 has onboard video and the BA2190 uses a Matrox Impression Plus. This configuration has 512 KB of L2 cache.
product.olivetti-m6-650-dp.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-650-dp.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-650-dp.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 14
product.olivetti-m6-650-dp.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.13.
